steps.body: You already know the trade: when a column sums to 10 or more, trade 10 of that place for 1 of the next place up, and carry that 1 into the next column as a **receipt**. The same trade works no matter how big the number gets — even when it cascades through several places in a row.

widget.prompt: Walk through 347,586 + 128,675 one column at a time.

panels.title: Ones
panels.body: 6 + 5 = 11. That's too big for one column — trade 10 ones for 1 ten. Write 1, carry the 1.

panels.title: Tens
panels.body: 8 + 7 + the carried 1 = 16. Trade 10 tens for 1 hundred. Write 6, carry the 1.

panels.title: Hundreds
panels.body: 5 + 6 + the carried 1 = 12. Trade 10 hundreds for 1 thousand. Write 2, carry the 1.

panels.title: Thousands
panels.body: 7 + 8 + the carried 1 = 16. Trade 10 thousands for 1 ten-thousand. Write 6, carry the 1.

panels.title: Ten-thousands and up
panels.body: 4 + 2 + the carried 1 = 7 — no more trading needed. Hundred-thousands: 3 + 1 = 4. The final sum is 476,261.

widget.continueFeedback: Keep walking through each column, left to right.
widget.successFeedback: 347,586 + 128,675 = 476,261 — four trades in a row, each one handled exactly the same way.

predict.prompt: Column addition runs right to left. Why that direction?

options.label: Small columns deserve to go first

predict.reveal: An overflowing column hands its extra ten leftward — starting at the ones lets every carry arrive before its column is judged. The direction is logistics, not custom.

explanationVariants: 8 + 4 = 12 in the tens column trades 10 tens for 1 hundred: write 2, carry 1. The full sum is 37,928.
Only the tens column needs a trade here; every other column sums under 10.

widget.prompt: What is 24,681 + 13,247? Tap each column to work it out; tap a carry to include it.

commonResults.feedback: 37,828 added each column separately without carrying the extra ten from 8 + 4 = 12 into the hundreds column. Carrying that 1 gives 37,928.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Add column by column from the ones; when a column reaches 10 or more, trade and carry.
widget.successFeedback: 24,681 + 13,247 = 37,928 — the ones make 8 with a carry that the tens must include.

steps.body: A carry can trigger ANOTHER carry — that's a cascade. Handle one column at a time, right to left, and just keep trading forward whenever a column's total (including anything carried in) reaches 10 or more. Nothing about the rule changes; it just repeats.

explanationVariants: 156,489 + 267,742 needs a trade in the ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, and ten-thousands columns — five trades in a row, landing on 424,231.
Each column's carry feeds the next, cascading all the way up to the hundred-thousands.

commonErrors.feedback: 313,121 added each column separately without ever carrying a trade forward. Carrying every trade through the cascade gives 424,231.
424,321 swaps two digits of the true answer. Working column by column with every carry gives 424,231.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Work column by column from the ones; carry every trade of 10 or more into the next column.

widget.prompt: Sort each column sum: does it need a trade (carry), or not?

items.feedback: 7 + 8 = 15 — that's 10 or more, so trade 10 for 1 of the next place.

widget.missFeedback: A trade happens whenever a column's sum reaches 10 or more.
widget.successFeedback: 7+8 and 9+9 both need a trade; 3+4 and 2+5 stay under 10 and need nothing extra.

explanationVariants: A carried 1 always joins the NEXT column to the left — the place value one rung higher.
The trade moves the receipt one place up, never sideways or back.

widget.prompt: The ones column sums to 14. You write 4 and carry the 1. Which column does that carried 1 join?

options.label: The tens column
options.feedback: The trade moves the receipt one place up — from ones into tens.

options.label: The ones column again
options.feedback: The ones column is already finished — its answer (4) is written. The carry moves UP, into tens.

options.label: The hundreds column
options.feedback: That skips a place. The carry moves exactly one column over, into tens — not two.

options.label: Nowhere — it's dropped
options.feedback: Dropping the carry loses value from the sum. It must be added into the next column: tens.

hints: Add the ones, tens, and hundreds columns first — watch for trades.
Several columns in a row will need a trade.
Carry each trade forward before moving to the next column.
explanationVariants: 268,547 + 154,786 cascades through several trades, landing on 423,333.
Column by column, carrying every trade, gives 423,333.

widget.prompt: A book sold 268,547 copies in its first year and 154,786 more in its second year. How many total copies were sold?

commonErrors.feedback: 312,223 added each column separately without carrying any trades forward. Carrying every trade gives 423,333.
422,333 is one trade short in an early column. Re-checking each column's carry gives 423,333.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Add column by column from the ones, carrying every trade of 10 or more.

takeaways: A column sum of 10 or more trades 10 of that place for 1 of the next place up.
A carry always joins the very next column to the left.
Carries can cascade — one trade can trigger another, and another.

concept.body: Quick rewind. **A column summing to 10 or more trades 10 for 1 of the next place, carried forward.** For 3,758 + 1,494: ones 8+4=12, write 2 carry 1; tens 5+9+1=15, write 5 carry 1; hundreds 7+4+1=12, write 2 carry 1; thousands 3+1+1=5. Result: 5,252.

explanationVariants: 6 + 7 = 13 in the ones column trades: write 3, carry 1 into tens.
The carried 1 makes the tens column 1 + 2 + 1 = 4.

options.feedback: 33 dropped the carry from the ones column. Carrying that 1 into tens gives 43.
313 wrote the two-digit column sum directly instead of trading. Carry the extra ten: 43.
